people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
translations.bsb: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
translations.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
translations.asv: And when he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. And those were the days of unleavened bread.
